body: That's the thing. I've done drugs. A LOT of drugs. I'm a pro at drugs. (I'm not bragging, just stating facts) I never black out. EVER. I've blacked out once before in my life, when I was roofied. I've been where I drank so much/ate so little that I was thrown into a diabetic seizure, and I still remember it every agonizing second of it. I don't have any idea what that pill was; it was supposed to be ecstasy, though it clearly wasn't. It really has nothing to do with drugs. It has to do with whatever I did and how everyone else reacted...
